texts: Unprepared Cliff Path lanterns die on cold-threshold nights.

review.notes: The adjectivally-restricted bare-kind subject correctly forces the distributing-rule route with the restriction as a premise conjunct rather than a kind-level relation, the participial modifier keeps its adjective form and is left undecomposed as an adjective compound, cold_threshold_night emits its head genus with the noun modifier unexposed, and the non-specific kind-level object keeps the bare kind filler. Bare generic TVs (0.9/0.9, no QuantifierPhrase) are right for a subject with no quantifier word.

fields.sentence: Unprepared Cliff Path lanterns die on cold-threshold nights.
parse: (: lantern_die_rule (Implication (And (Member $x lantern) (Possession $x cliff_path) (Member $x unprepared)) (And (Member (sk_die $x) die) (Patient (sk_die $x) $x) (Time (sk_die $x) cold_threshold_night))) (STV 0.9 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: (Inheritance cold_threshold threshold) is a second-level genus on a noun-modifier fragment, which the compound rules do not license: decomposition runs once to the head noun and stops, a noun modifier is never exposed, and the symbol cold_threshold occurs nowhere else in the parse.

q2_gaps: a bare-plural common-noun temporal adjunct naming a KIND of occasion ("on cold-threshold nights"): the licensed bare Time fillers are deictics, named times and day-parts, while Every/TimesPer need a stated period or rate, so no form covers a kind NP in the Time slot and the recurrence carried by the plural is silently dropped

a three-word compound kind whose modifier is itself a compound ("cold-threshold night"): 'decompose once, to single-word lemmas, then stop' does not say whether the inner compound modifier gets its own genus, so the emission is undetermined
review.notes: The proper-noun premodifier handling (one Name atom, kind atom from the name-internal kind word, opaque Possession on the head), the adjectivally-restricted kind subject routed to a distributing rule with the restriction as a premise conjunct, and Patient on the intransitive change-of-state subject all match the instruction set.

issues.reason: The half that stands is that no rule licenses a second-level genus - 'decompose once, to single-word lemmas, then stop' points against it and cold_threshold appears nowhere else in the parse - but the half that falls is that this is a defect: (Inheritance cold_threshold threshold) is true, well-typed and traceable to the words 'cold-threshold', and the reviewer's own second gap concedes the emission is undetermined, which the binding calibration line makes acceptable improvisation.

gaps_confirmed: A bare-plural common-noun temporal adjunct naming a KIND of occasion ('on cold-threshold nights'): the licensed bare Time fillers are deictics, named times and day-parts, and Every / TimesPer need a stated period or rate, so no form covers a kind NP in the Time slot and the recurrence carried by the plural is dropped.

A three-word compound kind whose modifier is itself a compound ('cold-threshold night'): 'decompose once, to single-word lemmas, then stop' does not settle whether the inner compound modifier gets its own genus, so the emission is undetermined.
adjudication.notes: The atom is orphaned rather than wrong - the modifier is correctly left unexposed on the compound itself, so nothing predicates cold_threshold of the night. The Northgate-pattern Possession on the proper-noun premodifier, the name-internal kind atom (Member cliff_path path), the adjectivally-restricted subject as premise conjuncts, and Patient on the change-of-state intransitive all match the instruction set.
